text:
Maya Chen: Quick alert — trial promo TRIAL-2024-BETA and contract credit CC-9001 have different expirations. TRIAL-2024-BETA expires 2026-03-29. We still show chargeable usage that hit the March invoice for Dedicated in us-east-1. Can finance look into applying remaining balances to avoid an overage? @Jonathan @billing-bot

Jonathan Park: Which invoice are we talking about? I see an item on INV-2026-03-812 for dedicated cluster reprovisioning. I can try to reassign credits but need the specific line amounts.

billing-bot: billing-export summary for org:redwood-inference:
```
CC-9001: $5,250.00 remaining
TRIAL-2024-BETA: $0.00 (expired consumption)
Applied_to: INV-2026-03-812 -> $4,900.00
```

Eric Li: That $4.9k mostly came from a provisioning surge in us-east-1 during a node rebuild (ENGINFRA-1987). If we move some credit into the reserved/committed pool for May we can keep the committed metrics clean and avoid invoice surprises when autoscaling kicks.

Jonathan Park: I can submit a manual allocation to cover the invoice and then transfer leftover to reserved ledger for May. Sarah — can you approve moving $4,250 into the reserved ledger and leaving a $1k buffer in CC-9001?

Sarah Patel: Approved. Leave $1,000 buffer. Move $4,250 to reserved for May. Please annotate the transfer so Forecast and Product can reconcile. :white_check_mark:

Oliver Grant: Quick question — if we move credits into the reserved ledger, will that affect our committed capacity reporting for renewals? Product needs the forecast to reflect true committed spend.

Jonathan Park: It won't rewrite historical usage. Reserved ledger allocation is an accounting change for future invoice application; committed capacity metrics are tied to provisioned reservations and actual usage. I'll add notes to the May forecast sheet indicating the ledger move so renewal numbers stay accurate.

Maya Chen: Please post the transaction id and ledger id when complete so ops/billing automation can pick it up. Also, I'll temporarily reduce autoscale max for us-east-1 during the next maintenance window to avoid another big burst.

billing-bot: Manual allocation request submitted: TXN-2026-04-0220. Status: pending_approval. Note: "Move $4,250 from CC-9001 to LEDGER-DED-MAY2026; keep $1,000 in CC-9001 as buffer."

Jonathan Park: TXN-2026-04-0220 approved and executed -> completed. CC-9001 remaining $1,000 buffer; $4,250 moved to LEDGER-DED-MAY2026. I updated INV-2026-03-812 reconciliation and left a reconciliation note.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Drop the recon link here and tag @ops so they remove any temporary autoscale caps once May starts.

Jonathan Park: Reconciliation doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/billing/recon/INV-2026-03-812 (internal). Ledger ID: LEDGER-DED-MAY2026. Forecast sheet updated and product notified.

Eric Li: I'll add a spend spike alert for us-east-1 that triggers at +25% over baseline during provisioning windows and reduce reprovision batch size. That should reduce accidental credit drain.

Maya Chen: Closed loop for now. If anyone spots unexpected charges after the move, please @finance with invoice id and TXN reference.
